Only 22% of the 3,940 active remote listings on Loker Dollar disclose any pay figure.

Two brand-design postings do share rates, both as fixed-price contracts: Stevens pays $3,000-$5,000 per project for a B2B SaaS logistics brand identity, and Sidekicks Creative Studio pays $1,500-$3,000 for a street-food brand. Across the wider market, 64% of listings are open to applicants from any country, so the pool is genuinely global.

The higher lump sum is not always the better deal. A $3,000-$5,000 fixed contract can mean short, high-pressure sprints, while a $1,500-$3,000 retainer offers steadier cash flow and room to upsell extra assets. Judge scope, timeline, and revision policy before comparing net income.

If you are hunting remote USD work: focus on listings that publish rates, build a logistics-focused case study if you want Stevens, and apply for both open brand-designer roles now.
